text:
evan: Noticed a consistent oddity in the int4 onboarding mirror: about 2.5% of sessions have two func_call starts hitting the adapter. Not a parse exception, but duplicates.
priya: I dug into mirror logs. Both starts look semantically identical but come with different transient ids. Typically only one downstream return is consumed.
marta: Any timing pattern? Is second start usually right after a retry?
ev an: Median gap ~150ms, tail up to 6s. Correlates with sessions flagged as "warm KV" where first token emission is delayed. Runtime sometimes issues a retry then the continuing stream emits the call again.
priya: Adapter currently dedupes by request_id which changes on retries. So it treats retries as new invocations.
marta: Quick mitigation: compute a semantic fingerprint in the adapter: canonicalize args JSON (sort keys, normalize escapes, remove trailing commas, normalize whitespace), then hash. Dedupe by (fingerprint) within a sliding time window, like 5s.
ev an: Good. Edge cases: legitimate retry with modified args must not be suppressed. Add a delta check: if normalized arg edit distance > 0.03 then do not dedupe and increment a suppressed_retry metric.
priya: Also capture raw stream chunks for ~100 failures (store in restricted bucket) and keep repaired versions side-by-side. Repair heuristics can hide the root cause, so keep raw.
marta: For canonicalization include unicode normalization (NFC), unify common escape sequences (\n vs \u000A), collapse repeated whitespace to a single space, and remove insignificant trailing commas in arrays/objects. Hash with xxhash64 for speed.
ev an: Short-term experiment: enable fingerprint dedupe on 1% of raven-int4-canary traffic for 12h and run mirror harness. Collect metrics: duplicate_tool_start rate, suppressed_retry_count, delta in p95 latency. Abort if tool error or latency rises >0.5%.
build-bot: @evan Roll request: raven-int4-canary flag=fp_dedupe=on scope=1% queued.
priya: I'll wire the mirror harness: sample 20k sessions, label duplicates, compute tokenization delta histogram, and store 150 raw+repaired artifacts.
marta: Also add unit tests that include tricky chunking cases (escaped quotes, trailing commas, mixed newlines) that must canonicalize to identical fingerprint. Fuzz for collisions up to 1M samples.
ev an: Long-term plan: generate idempotency tokens in the server runtime and preserve them across retries. That eliminates the need for heuristics, but runtime change is heavier.
priya: For rollout safety, make the adapter dedupe opt-in via flag and start small. If dup rate drops from ~2.5% -> <0.25% without raising suppressed_retry significantly, we can broaden.
marta: Ops note: ensure downstream tool servers are resilient to duplicate starts (idempotent ops or quick debounce). If not, add circuit-breaker in adapter for heavy ops.
ev an: Action items: priya build harness + initial metrics, marta open CL for fingerprint algorithm + tests, evan draft rollback playbook. Post first numbers after 250k mirrored requests.
priya: Will post CSV and sample link. Closing for now.
